> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **23** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `d4f287be8aa2e231669e0cb999eb64a201b2c6d9` — the merge of head `f3b41646a354713e2abc1159ab6b01284a3d2018` into base `fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin d4f287be8aa2e231669e0cb999eb64a201b2c6d9 && git checkout d4f287be8aa2e231669e0cb999eb64a201b2c6d9
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a f3b41646a354713e2abc1159ab6b01284a3d2018 && git checkout -B drift-repro fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a && git merge --no-ff f3b41646a354713e2abc1159ab6b01284a3d2018

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cbvcmv8YWFhFJwzjKL

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 组织「强制多因素认证」（`sys_organization.require_mfa`）三处跟进：两步验证没开时的拒存提示改为按管理员的语言显示（四语，英文原句不变）；开启成功的那次保存，应答里带一条提示，写明成员要在几天宽限期内绑定验证器；字段帮助写明需要 `OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=true`。
- **为什么改：** 原来中文界面下拒存提示是英文；组织管理员读不到宽限期设置（没有 `manage_platform_settings`），控制台只能写死「7 天」；帮助里也没说要先开两步验证（#30411，#30293 的跟进项）。
- **风险与回滚：** 拒存的状态码、错误码和字段结构不变；提示走写入应答里已有的可选 `notice` 字段，不新增成员；宽限天数和 MFA 闸门读同一个函数。回滚即撤本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/organization-mfa-enrollment-guard.ts`，再看 `auth-manager-password-session-policy.ts` 抽出的 `resolveMfaGracePeriodDays`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/organization-mfa-enrollment-guard.test.ts`。
- **需要您做的：** 无，席位经合并队列落地（非受管面，484 行，非 BREAKING）。
- **席位意见：** ACCEPT。宽限期走已有的写入应答 `notice`，不加读口，也不碰公开的 `/auth/config`；保存提示里的天数和闸门同源，A5b 消融钉住闸门读数没动。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:server#2 · head `f3b41646a354713e2abc1159ab6b01284a3d2018`

- **形态:** draft, author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay `pr_create`), no assignee, no review request; 12 files, +464 −20 against its merge base; `check-governed-merges --pr 30529`: NOT governed (0 of 12 paths), 484 lines ≤ 3000. Title has no `!`.
- **Review face:** `TIER_DEFAULT` (`Clause-②: no`: item 2 rides the create / update answer's existing optional `notice` member, `WRITE_ANSWER_NOTICE_DESCRIPTION` in `@objectstack/spec/api` — no new member on a published read; items 1 and 3 are copy; no spec or governed path, no narrowing), written here by the seat. Matches the order's declaration rule ("naming an existing read ⇒ `no`").
- **Premise measured (item 2):** `GET /api/settings/auth` answers `403 SETTINGS_FORBIDDEN` to an organization administrator (`readPermission: manage_platform_settings`, which `organization_admin` does not hold) on a real boot — so the order's preferred fallback shape (the accepted save answers the grace period) applies.
- **Seat read:** the guard's refusal now takes `callerLocale(ctx)` (`ctx.session.locale`, matched by core `resolveLocale` over the four locales the copy carries; English fallback); envelope unchanged (`400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, one `require_mfa` / `invalid_value` entry), English byte-identical. An admitted turn-on (insert, update from stored off, update without `previous`) calls `ctx.notice(…)` when `ctx.notice` is bound and the days are finite; a clear, another column or a re-save of a stored `true` answers none. Days come from `AuthManager.getMfaGracePeriodDays()` → `resolveMfaGracePeriodDays`, now the one reading the gate's clock also uses (gate arithmetic moved, not changed: A5b red when the default moves). `auth-plugin.ts`: one option at the guard's registration, outside `applySettings` (#30312's ground). `getMfaGracePeriodDays` is `@internal`.
- **Item 3:** `require_mfa` description source changed; `en.objects.generated.ts` regenerated with `pnpm i18n:extract`; the three translated values re-translated by hand (keys unchanged), which the Documentation Guardrails allow for translated-locale values.
- **Pins and ablations:** 56 cases in `organization-mfa-enrollment-guard.test.ts` (refusal zh-CN/en and the matching table; notice per turn-on, 0/1-day sentences, silences; real ObjectQL engine over the real `sys_organization`; real `AuthPlugin` `kernel:ready` registration; gate reading unchanged end to end on better-auth). A1, A2b, A3, A4, A5b each red, restored.
- **Serial:** PR #30447 (#30312) edits `auth-plugin.ts` `applySettings` and the floor deps, no overlap with the guard registration line; the later lander merges `main`. #30449 already in this head.
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, line-initial in PR body and changeset; `patch` for `@objectstack/plugin-auth` and `@objectstack/platform-objects`.
- **Dev readings (`f3b41646`):** plugin-auth 4001 passed, platform-objects 1532 passed, derived gates 66/66 (0 NOT-MEASURED), `pnpm lint` 0, full dogfood 419 files / 3492 passed. os-dev-report 6660255597.
- **Out of scope → carrier:** the console will show the server's `notice` beside its own hard-coded "7 days" line (ui half — the seat files it to `domain:ui` after landing); `@objectstack/client` has no settings read, not needed by this shape.
- **门禁 check-runs:** in progress at ACCEPT; the seat queues once every check is green or an expected skip.
- **落地条款:** Fixes #30411. Ordinary queue landing by this seat: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` on this head.
